# PROMPT 06
# PRODUCE COMPLETE ATTACK STATE

Version: 1.0

Status: Production

Priority: CRITICAL

Depends On:

- global-art-rules
- reference-atlas
- validation-infrastructure
- validate-sword(APPROVED)

---

# PURPOSE

Produce the complete attack animation family.

This is the first state allowed to significantly alter the body posture.

However:

The attack must still preserve identity.

The player must always perceive:

"The same girl is attacking."

Never:

"A new combat character."

---

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENT

The attack must be convincing WITHOUT:

- trails
- particles
- glow
- motion blur
- screen shake
- sound

The animation itself must communicate the attack.

Effects may only reinforce it.

Effects may never replace it.

---

# SOURCE OF TRUTH

The source atlas MUST be discovered automatically.

Do not assume filenames.

Do not assume hashes.

The implementation must:

1. Locate the atlas referenced by OFFICIAL_FRAMES.
2. Compute SHA-256.
3. Store the result in:

docs/character-reference-atlas/discovered-source.json

The discovered atlas becomes the canonical source for the remainder of the pipeline.

If multiple candidates exist:

STOP.

Report all candidates.

Require manual approval.

Do not continue.

OFFICIAL_FRAMES

Character Art Bible

Global Art Rules

Reference Atlas

Approved Carry State

Approved Sword State

---

# ABSOLUTE RULE

The attack state extends the atlas.

It does NOT replace the character.

It does NOT redesign the character.

It does NOT create a combat version.

---

# REQUIRED SPRITES

## ATTACK RIGHT

attack_right_prepare

attack_right_mid

attack_right_finish

---

## ATTACK LEFT

attack_left_prepare

attack_left_mid

attack_left_finish

---

## ATTACK UP

attack_up_prepare

attack_up_mid

attack_up_finish

---

## ATTACK DOWN

attack_down_prepare

attack_down_mid

attack_down_finish

---

# TOTAL

12 sprites

---

# ATTACK STRUCTURE

Every attack follows:

PREPARE

↓

IMPACT

↓

RECOVERY

---

# PREPARE FRAME

Purpose:

Build anticipation.

The character prepares the motion.

The player understands an attack is about to happen.

---

# IMPACT FRAME

Purpose:

Maximum force.

Strongest silhouette.

Most readable frame.

If a player sees only this frame:

The attack must be immediately recognizable.

---

# RECOVERY FRAME

Purpose:

Return to neutral.

Avoid teleportation.

Avoid snapping.

Preserve physical continuity.

---

# DIRECTION RULES

## RIGHT

Must clearly attack to the right.

Not a sword rotation.

A body action.

---

## LEFT

Must clearly attack to the left.

Not a mirrored artifact.

Not a broken interpolation.

---

## UP

Must clearly attack upward.

Not a right attack rotated.

Must have its own body language.

---

## DOWN

Must clearly attack downward.

Not a right attack rotated.

Must have its own body language.

---

# IDENTITY RULE

Allowed changes:

- arms
- hands
- torso twist
- attack posture
- sword orientation

---

Forbidden changes:

- face
- eyes
- mouth
- hair
- dress
- proportions
- rendering style
- age perception

---

# ATTACK RULE

The body drives the attack.

The sword follows the body.

The impact follows the sword.

The trail follows the impact.

Correct hierarchy:

Body

↓

Arm

↓

Sword

↓

Effect

Never the reverse.

---

# FEW SHOT 01

CORRECT

attack_mid

↓

No particles

↓

No trail

↓

Player understands:

"Attack"

APPROVE

---

# FEW SHOT 02

INCORRECT

attack_mid

↓

Looks like sword rotation

↓

No body engagement

REJECT

---

# FEW SHOT 03

INCORRECT

Trail enabled

↓

Attack readable

Trail disabled

↓

Attack unreadable

REJECT

---

# FEW SHOT 04

CORRECT

Trail disabled

↓

Attack still obvious

↓

Trail only enhances it

APPROVE

---

# FEW SHOT 05

INCORRECT

Different face

Different character

Different rendering

Combat redesign

REJECT

---

# DELIVERABLES

Generate:

attack-spritesheet.png

attack-preview.gif

attack-comparison-sheet.png

attack-direction-sheet.png

attack-frame-report.json

---

# DIRECTION DOCUMENTATION

Generate:

attack-direction-validation.png

Show:

Right

Left

Up

Down

Side by side.

---

# REVIEW REQUIREMENTS

Review every frame individually.

Review every sequence.

Review every direction.

---

# QUESTIONS

Can the attack be understood?

Can direction be understood?

Does identity remain intact?

Does the sword remain attached?

Is the body contributing?

---

# AUTOMATED VALIDATION

Execute:

character-state-validator.js

Execute:

character-state-review.js

---

# FAILURE CONDITIONS

Immediate rejection if:

- attack only works with effects
- direction unreadable
- identity drift
- clipping
- floating sword
- missing frame
- broken timing

---

# APPROVAL CRITERIA

12 sprites complete.

All four directions readable.

Identity preserved.

Sword attached.

Attack readable without effects.

No clipping.

No animation artifacts.

---

# BLOCKING RULE

Attack validation must succeed before integration may begin.
